units.text: INT. BAKERY - PROOFING ROOM - NIGHT
Warm, yeasty dark.
Steel racks of dough rise under damp cloths.
A single bulb burns over a flour-dusted table.
NAOMI BETTENCOURT, 30s, sleeves pushed to the elbow, shapes loaves with unhurried hands.
Humming.
At peace.
The back door scrapes.
Cold air wedges in.
You're early.
units.name: NAOMI

units.text: A shape in the doorway, snow on her shoulders.
LINNEA ASHWORTH, 30s, long coat, a suitcase in one hand, steps into the light.
Her face is thinner than Naomi remembers.
I took the first train.
units.name: LINNEA

units.text: You said Friday.
units.name: NAOMI

units.text: It is Friday.
units.name: LINNEA

units.text: Naomi looks at the clock over the oven.
She almost laughs.
So it is.
units.name: NAOMI

units.text: She wipes her hands on her apron.
She does not cross the room.
Neither does Linnea.
Between them, the racks tick softly as the dough breathes.
You look well.
units.name: LINNEA

units.text: I look like flour.
units.name: NAOMI

units.text: That's what I meant.
units.name: LINNEA

units.text: Naomi smiles, finally, and gestures to a stool.
Linnea sets down the suitcase and sits.
She watches Naomi's hands work, the push, the fold, the turn.
I thought about this room every night.
units.name: LINNEA

units.text: I thought about you every night.
units.name: NAOMI

units.text: They speak at the same moment, quietly, a little afraid.
I'm sorry I left.
units.name: NAOMI

units.text: I'm sorry I left.
units.name: LINNEA

units.text: Nobody moves.
Then Naomi laughs, wet-eyed, and Linnea does too, and the tension breaks like crust.
Stay. Please.
units.name: NAOMI

units.text: I can't promise.
units.name: LINNEA

units.text: I'm not asking for a promise. Just the morning bake.
units.name: NAOMI

units.text: Linnea rises.
She takes the other end of the table.
She picks up a knife and starts scoring loaves, matching rhythm.
For a time they work in easy silence.
Then Linnea sets down the knife.
She slides her left hand into her coat pocket and withdraws a thin envelope, stamped with a hospital seal.
Before the morning, I should show you this.
units.name: LINNEA

units.text: Naomi looks at the seal.
The humming in the room seems to stop.
Linnea.
units.name: NAOMI

units.text: Read it. Then decide about the bread.
units.name: LINNEA
